SEQUENCED
How this exchange works

Orders match by best price, then arrival order. Executions use the resting order’s price. Open orders reserve USDT or ETH; cancellation releases the reserve. Self trading and insufficient balances are rejected. The demo’s ETH and USDT balances are simulated. State lives in this browser tab and resets on reload.

The demo resets the session, then Bob buys 0.05 ETH from Alice at 3,250.00 USDT per ETH. Bob pays 162.50 USDT, Alice receives 162.50 USDT, and the remaining 0.07 ETH stay on Alice’s order.

Inspired by Brian Nigito’s How to Build an Exchange. Independently built; no affiliation with Jane Street. This simulator does not reproduce its distributed infrastructure or performance.

NONCUSTODIAL
01

No exchange deposit

No Neon balance, withdrawal queue, or operator wallet. Funds move through Uniswap during the transaction.

02

You approve the movement

Every approval and swap requires your wallet signature. No unlimited approvals or hidden platform fees.

03

Fixed contract, fixed recipient

The router is fixed in this release. Swap proceeds go to your connected wallet. Neon has no admin key to the router.
